reader.requirement: At --std 85 the OPTIONAL phrase of a report file's SELECT has effect only on OPEN EXTEND: an absent OPTIONAL report file opened EXTEND is created with status 05, a present one is extended with 00, an absent non-optional one fails with 35; OPEN OUTPUT is unaffected by OPTIONAL (00, file created or replaced).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility by Edition: Table 19 sharing arbitration, off at 85; does not touch the OPTIONAL/EXTEND arms

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior in SequentialConnector.cs (no match) and FileConnector.cs (Edition property, SharingFacilityInEffect only); FileControlBinder sets FileModel.Optional from grp.OPTIONAL() with no edition test; VersionConformancePass OPTIONAL() checks are the formal-parameter phrase only.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf19_04 covers absent OPTIONAL EXTEND (05), reopen (00), absent OPTIONAL OUTPUT (00), absent non-optional EXTEND (35); not exercised: a present OPTIONAL file extended (content kept and appended), OUTPUT of a present OPTIONAL file (replaced), the statement after the failed OPEN

probes.printed: R1 EXTEND PRESENT 00; R1 CLOSE 00; R3 OUTPUT PRESENT 00; R2 ERR 35; AFTER R2 35; R2 ERR 42; AFTER CLOSE R2 42; PRE.DAT = PRE1,EX01; OLD.DAT = NEW1; MISS.DAT not created (same at --std 2023)
probes.expected: present OPTIONAL EXTEND: normal open 00, records appended; OUTPUT: OPTIONAL has no effect, file replaced; absent non-optional EXTEND: 35, file not created; CLOSE of the file not open: 42

probes.printed: RPT OPEN EXTEND 05 / RPT EXTEND REOPEN 00 / RPT OPEN OUTPUT 00 / REQ OPEN EXTEND 35 (MATCH)
probes.expected: as the witness derives from §1985:XIII.2.3.4 GR2 and the OPEN table

reader.notes: A report file is a sequential connector; SequentialConnector.OpenCore's Extend arm returns 35 for an absent non-optional file, creates an absent optional file and returns 05, and appends to a present one; the Output arm ignores IsOptional. No edition switch on the path; the OPEN-after-failure CLOSE giving 42 is the same at 2023.

refuter.evidence: run_probe --std 85 r3abs.cob (runs/r3abs-001): an ABSENT OPTIONAL report file opened EXTEND gives 05, is created and receives the report's line (AB01), CLOSE 00, a second OPEN EXTEND gives 00 and appends (two records read back); an absent OPTIONAL report file with no FILE STATUS and no declarative continues after OPEN EXTEND and its file holds AB04. r3inp.cob --compile-only (runs/r3inp-001): OPEN INPUT and OPEN I-O of an OPTIONAL report file refused COBOL2371 (the only modes left to OPTIONAL are excluded). The reader covered present EXTEND (00), OUTPUT replace, absent non-optional EXTEND 35. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.2.3.4 GR2 the text is in GR2.
